reports.title: Ameresco Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

lines: Fourth quarter and full year updated guidance is shown in the table below and reflects the inclusion of 100% of the operating results of our consolidated joint ventures as well as the recast of our 2026 performance as a result of adopting a tax-based accounting policy for transferable tax credits, which is a retrospective application of this accounting policy.

desk.headline: Revenue up 10% to $580m, beat; record $7.2bn backlog; 2026 outlook recast for new accounting, operations view unchanged

numbers.eps_basis: adjusted (new method: includes 100% of consolidated JVs; prior year recast for tax-credit accounting)

other.label: GAAP diluted EPS
other.change: vs $1.39 a year ago (recast, large tax benefit)

results: Revenue rose 10% to $580m: Projects +9% to $446m, Energy Assets +21% to $75m and O&M +20% to $37m.
Gross margin widened to 18.7%, helped by business mix, execution and lower depreciation after energy assets were given longer useful lives.
GAAP EPS was $0.59 (vs $1.39 recast). Adjusted EPS of $0.88 now counts 100% of joint ventures; on the old method it was $0.60, against a $0.57 consensus.
New awards of $875m and $737m converted to signed contracts lifted total project backlog 39% to a record $7.2bn, including a $200m data-centre scope expansion.
Cash from operations was -$8.9m in the quarter (-$60.3m over nine months as unbilled revenue grew); cash was $128.5m and corporate leverage 2.9x, with $106m of new financing secured.

guidance.summary: Ameresco reset its 2026 ranges to the new accounting (100% of joint ventures and a tax-credit policy change) and said its operating outlook has not changed. Full-year adjusted EPS is now $1.85-1.95 (was $1.15-1.35 on the old basis); revenue $2.13-2.15bn.

points: Awarded backlog passed $4.5bn, up about 70% y/y, though Q3 awards were roughly half of Q2's record $1.8bn.
Management pointed to new work in on-site nuclear for the Army and a first balance-of-plant contract on a microreactor project.
Data-centre awarded backlog is about $1.7bn; management said a pause in data-centre activity has cleared after the election.
Management said gross margin is running above the 17-18% range and the range may prove conservative.
An interim finance executive presented the numbers in place of the CFO.
call.source: Call coverage: Ameresco's Accounting-Assisted Beat Masks An In-Line Quarter — Earnings Whispers (via Finviz), 9 Nov 2026

watch: Whether cash flow improves as large projects are billed; unbilled revenue rose about $205m this year.
Q4 delivery against $625-650m revenue and conversion of awarded backlog into contracts.
Data-centre and nuclear awards, and any news on the finance leadership.
